annotations.title: Audit Stack Configuration for Breaking Drift

description: Read-only audit of a package.json, requirements.txt, or .mcp.json configuration string against 258 live AI Agent SDKs and MCP servers. Flags breaking major version deltas, unpinned @latest MCP servers, and outdated dependencies with exact pin commands. Requires no authentication and returns a structured JSON report.
